handling.mchjong.shuffle: Sweep the face-down tiles across the felt to shuffle.

mchjong.ponder.table_placement.text_1: Leave a clear 3 x 3 area for the table, with room above its playing surface.
mchjong.ponder.table_placement.text_2: Place the table at the center of this area. Its frame fills the surrounding space.
mchjong.ponder.table_placement.text_3: Place stools two blocks from the center, on the sides used by your game.
mchjong.ponder.table_placement.text_4: Both ordinary and automatic tables use this compact arrangement.
mchjong.ponder.table_equipment.text_1: Prepare the tiles required by the rules: 136 for four players or 108 for three, with matching material, backs and face design. Spare tiles may stay in the box.
mchjong.ponder.table_equipment.text_2: Right-click the table to open its storage. It holds up to two mahjong boxes inside.
mchjong.ponder.table_equipment.text_3: Use a cloth on the table. A cloth and a complete set make the table ready for play.
mchjong.ponder.table_equipment.text_4: Open the side drawers to store point sticks and hand payments to the other players.
mchjong.ponder.table_equipment.text_5: Manage boxes through table storage in the lobby. Crouch-click the tabletop with empty hands to collect the cloth.
mchjong.ponder.table_playing.text_1: Click a stool to sit and open the table controls. Click it again to reopen the controls while seated.
mchjong.ponder.table_playing.text_2: Choose three- or four-player mahjong and a rule preset in the lobby, then have every player ready up.
mchjong.ponder.table_playing.text_3: On an ordinary table, sweep the loose tiles to shuffle, drag them toward your wall, then pull wall tiles toward your hand.
mchjong.ponder.table_playing.text_4: An automatic table handles shuffling, wall construction, dealing and drawing for you.
mchjong.ponder.table_playing.text_5: Select tiles on the table to discard. The controls offer legal calls, riichi and winning actions.
mchjong.ponder.table_playing.text_6: Close the overlay to look around while seated. Use Minecraft's sneak control after closing it to dismount.
replay.mchjong.delete_note: This permanently removes the replay from your archive. Other participants keep their copies, and local exports are not deleted.

settings.mchjong.river_hint: Hiding the rivers always keeps the remaining wall count visible. Game rules and replay records are unchanged.
